resources.string: Language, local formats, and reading direction
Uses the device’s preferred languages. If none are available, uses English.
Dates, times, and numbers follow the selected language and region. The time zone remains the device’s time zone.
The interface direction follows the language. Content and positions on document pages are preserved.
Changing the language reopens the current screen to apply it.
Flags identify the regional variant, which can also be used in other countries.
